summary: Decodes packed 16-bit ARGB texture pixels (one RGB332 byte plus one alpha byte) to 32-bit float RGBA. Computes the source pixel pointer as this[6] (field 0x18) plus a3 * this[1045] (field 0x1054) plus a2 * this[1044] (field 0x1050). For this[1046] (field 0x1058) pixels it extracts 3-bit red, 3-bit green and 2-bit blue (scaled by 0.14285715 and 0.33333334) from the first byte and an eight-bit alpha (scaled by 0.0039215689) from the second byte, writing four floats per pixel. If this[4] (field 0x10) is non-zero, calls ContactManifoldCleanup on the decoded float RGBA buffer.

operations.description: Compute the source pixel pointer as this[6] (field 0x18) plus a3 * this[1045] (field 0x1054) plus a2 * this[1044] (field 0x1050).
Iterate over this[1046] (field 0x1058) pixels, consuming two bytes per pixel and writing four floats per pixel.

Decode the four channels: red = ((*v5 >> 5) & 7) * 0.14285715, green = ((*v5 >> 2) & 7) * 0.14285715, blue = (*v5 & 3) * 0.33333334, alpha = *(v5 + 1) * 0.0039215689, using float scales held in the global constants.
Advance the input pointer by two bytes and the output pointer by four floats each iteration.
If this[4] (field 0x10) is non-zero, run the post-processing cleanup on the decoded buffer.
Call ContactManifoldCleanup(this, output_start) where output_start is the base of the decoded float RGBA buffer.
